sections.text: FAST MOVING...LOW-AMPLITUDE SHORTWAVE TROUGH WILL CONTINUE EWD ACROSS THE CENTRAL PLAINS THIS AFTERNOON AND THE MID/UPPER MS RIVER VALLEY LATER TONIGHT. sections.title: MO/IA/IL TODAY
sections.text: A MID LEVEL TROUGH OVER THE CENTRAL PLAINS...WITH EMBEDDED SPEED MAXIMA OVER KS AND SD...WILL CONTINUE TO PROGRESS EWD TO THE MS VALLEY TONIGHT. AN ASSOCIATED SURFACE CYCLONE IN N CENTRAL KS WILL DEVELOP ENEWD TO WRN IL THIS EVENING AND LOWER MI TONIGHT...ALONG A WARM FRONT LIFTING NWD FROM THE I-70 CORRIDOR. THE SD SPEED MAX IS CONTRIBUTING TO THE MAINTENANCE OF AN ELEVATED THUNDERSTORM CLUSTER ACROSS NW IA THIS MORNING...WHILE SEPARATE ELEVATED THUNDERSTORMS HAVE BEEN DEVELOPING ALONG AND IMMEDIATELY N OF THE SURFACE WARM FRONT IN MO/IL. CONVECTION WILL LIKELY BEGIN TO FILL THE GAP BETWEEN THE CLUSTERS DURING FROM LATE MORNING INTO THIS AFTERNOON ACROSS NE MO/SRN IA/NW IL. RELATIVELY COOL TEMPERATURE PROFILES AND STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES /-20 C AT 500 MB AND 7-7.5 C/KM LAPSE RATES FROM 700-500 MB/ HAVE CONTRIBUTED TO SUFFICIENT ELEVATED INSTABILITY FOR STORMS WITH MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL ACROSS W/NW IA. THE PRIMARY THREAT FOR LARGE HAIL WILL SHIFT SEWD THROUGH THE DAY TO THE VICINITY OF THE WARM FRONT ACROSS NERN MO/SRN IA/W CENTRAL IL...WHERE LOW-LEVEL WAA WILL BE FOCUSED AND AN INFLUX OF LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE BENEATH STEEP MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL SUPPORT MUCAPE OF 1000-1500 J

sections.text: AS THE COLD FRONT OVERTAKES THE REMNANT DRYLINE THIS EVENING INTO EARLY TONIGHT ACROSS MO/ERN OK AND THE CAP WEAKENS FROM THE W...A BAND OF THUNDERSTORMS IS EXPECTED TO DEVELOP ALONG THE FRONT. THIS CONVECTION SHOULD BACK-BUILD WSWWD TO THE SE OK/EXTREME NE TX AREA AND PERSIST THROUGH 12Z AS THE SURFACE FRONT STALLS NEAR THE RED RIVER. THOUGH THE STRONGER LLJ CORE WILL DEVELOP NEWD INTO THE OH VALLEY OVERNIGHT...DEEP LAYER VERTICAL SHEAR AND INSTABILITY WILL REMAIN LARGE ENOUGH TO SUPPORT A THREAT FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND LARGE HAIL WITH THE COLD FRONTAL STORMS THROUGH EARLY FRIDAY. A TORNADO OR TWO MAY ALSO OCCUR WITH ANY EMBEDDED SUPERCELLS...MAINLY EARLY TONIGHT BEFORE THE LOW-LEVEL FLOW WEAKENS. ..THOMPSON.. 02/26/2009

sections.text: THIS AFTERNOON A COLD FRONT EXTENDS FROM A SURFACE LOW IN NW MO SWWD THROUGH NW OK INTO THE TX PANHANDLE. SURFACE LOW IS FORECAST TO DEEPEN AS IT LIFTS NE INTO THE GREAT LAKES...WHILE TRAILING COLD FRONT OVERTAKES THE DRYLINE AS IT ADVANCES EAST INTO THE MID MS VALLEY THIS EVENING. sections.text: ...MID MS VALLEY TO NERN TX... WELL DEFINED UPPER VORT MAX IS SHIFTING EAST ALONG THE MN/IA BORDER WITH TRAILING SHORTWAVE TROUGH EXTENDING SWD ALONG THE KS/MO BORDER.
